name: Sanguivore
descriptionTemplate: Leigh gains [Energy:Arg1] Aliemus. {Rouse}: After Leigh plays a card, {Embryo Fusion} +[Blood:Arg2].
lore:
"Shame... Shame..."
The girl cowered in the corner of the kitchen, unable to wipe away the bloodstain at the corner of her mouth.
She endured accusations from her closest kin but was powerless to defend herself.
From that day on, the girl lost her name.
She disappeared from the eyes of the world, like a drop of water merging into the ceaselessly flowing river of rumors.
